property_summary: For every caller other than the keeper, executeBatchDeposit must revert (CallerNotKeeper) and leave dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance untouched; the mutant deletes the access check so a non-keeper call succeeds and advances state, making the call not revert.
change_summary: Delete the access check in the onlyKeeper modifier so any caller (not just the keeper) can execute executeBatchDeposit, which resets dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance to 0 where the original would revert.
